title: The cheaper quote landed *dearer*
subtitle: Illustrative numbers, per unit: Supplier A vs Supplier B

stages.name: Supplier price
stages.desc: What the quote says. Only the starting point. A 100, B 94.

stages.name: Freight
stages.desc: Distance, mode and load fill. A 4, B 11.

stages.name: Duties and insurance
stages.desc: Set by item code, origin and value. A 10, B 9.

stages.name: Handling
stages.desc: Port, clearing, unloading and put-away. A 2, B 4.

stages.name: Landed cost
stages.desc: A lands at 116, B at 118. The cheaper quote costs more.

takeaway: Compare suppliers on landed cost per unit, never on quoted price alone.

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
